<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
function tid($name){ $t = wp_insert_term($name,'product_cat'); return is_wp_error($t) ? $t->get_error_data() : $t['term_id']; }
$ropa = tid('Ropa'); $acc = tid('Accesorios'); $dig = tid('Digitales');

function simple($name,$price,$cat,$desc,$sale=''){
  $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
  $p->set_name($name); $p->set_regular_price($price);
  if($sale!=='') $p->set_sale_price($sale);
  $p->set_short_description($desc); $p->set_description($desc);
  $p->set_category_ids([$cat]); $p->set_manage_stock(true); $p->set_stock_quantity(25);
  $p->set_status('publish'); return $p->save();
}
simple('Taza de cerámica',180,$acc,'Taza artesanal de 350 ml.');
simple('Gorra negra',250,$acc,'Gorra ajustable de algodón.',199);
simple('Mochila urbana',890,$acc,'Mochila impermeable de 20 L.');

$d = new WC_Product_Simple();
$d->set_name('Guía PDF: Marketing para tu tienda'); $d->set_regular_price(149);
$d->set_virtual(true); $d->set_downloadable(true);
$d->set_short_description('Producto digital de ejemplo.'); $d->set_category_ids([$dig]);
$d->set_status('publish'); $d->save();

$v = new WC_Product_Variable();
$v->set_name('Playera básica'); $v->set_short_description('Playera de algodón en varias tallas.');
$v->set_category_ids([$ropa]);
$a = new WC_Product_Attribute(); $a->set_name('Talla'); $a->set_options(['S','M','L']);
$a->set_position(0); $a->set_visible(true); $a->set_variation(true);
$v->set_attributes([$a]); $v->set_status('publish'); $vid = $v->save();
foreach(['S'=>299,'M'=>299,'L'=>329] as $t=>$pr){
  $var = new WC_Product_Variation(); $var->set_parent_id($vid);
  $var->set_attributes(['talla'=>$t]); $var->set_regular_price($pr);
  $var->set_manage_stock(true); $var->set_stock_quantity(10); $var->save();
}
WC_Product_Variable::sync($vid);

$c = new WC_Coupon(); $c->set_code('BIENVENIDO10'); $c->set_discount_type('percent'); $c->set_amount(10); $c->save();
